title: VIX futures April 2027 expiration (SOQ settlement) — the front contract into the 04-16 monthly expiration
source: EST: cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement and its machine-readable CSV www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04, both fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 536,802 bytes and HTTP 200, 1,731 bytes) and parsed row-by-row by this session into 55 contract rows across 12 roots. The CSV carries the live row `VX,VX/J7,2027-04-21,21.0267`, i.e. Cboe is already listing and daily-settling the April-2027 VIX future against this date. Deterministic cross-check, which reproduces on all nine listed VX rows: the expiration is the Wednesday exactly 30 days before the following third-Friday SPX expiration — 2027-04-21 + 30d = Friday 2027-05-21, May 2027's third Friday, an unadjusted Friday with no NYSE closure (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars fetched direct the same day, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes: the nearest 2027 holidays either side are Good Friday 2027-03-26 and Memorial Day 2027-05-31). Filed estimate, NOT confirmed, purely because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the evidence is the same OCC:-grade class that promoted the siblings vix-expiration-2026-09-16 and vix-expiration-2027-03-17, so this entry is confirm-ready at its own initial research.
notes: PROPOSED during the opex-2027-04-16 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), 5 days after that event and therefore inside the deterministic screen's own +/-5-day adjacency window. Why this one when the vix-expiration-2027-03-17 sweep explicitly declined to propose it: from that corridor it sat ~35 days out and was a mere repetition of the same event type; from the 2027-04-16 corridor it is load-bearing for a finding that ledger actually makes. VIX contracts AM-settle to a Special Opening Quotation built from the opening auction of a SINGLE SPX/SPXW series exactly 30 days out, so this contract's own reference is the 2027-05-21 monthly expiration, NOT the 2027-04-16 one it follows by three sessions. The consequence recorded here so a later pulse need not re-derive it: because VX/H7 already expired 2027-03-17, the front VIX future into the 2027-04-16 monthly expiration (opex-2027-04-16, estimate) is THIS contract, with only 3 trading sessions of life left — against 23 for the front contract into the 2027-03-19 quarterly witching. April's monthly expiration therefore sits nearly on top of its own vol-complex expiration where March's witching did not. Two qualifications logged rather than dropped. (1) VXM/J7 is NOT listed: the Mini-VIX rows on both fetched surfaces stop at VXM/G7 (2027-02-17), so this entry rests on the VX row alone and a Mini-VIX leg must not be asserted from it. (2) This settlement lands 6 sessions before the April 2027 FOMC decision (fomc-2027-04-28, estimate) and 2 sessions after the blackout opens (fomc-blackout-start-2027-04-17, estimate), so unlike its March sibling it does NOT settle on a central-bank decision morning; the FOMC-morning-settlement structure belongs to vix-expiration-2027-03-17 and is not re-litigated here. Impact LOW: it supports one execution guard (nothing trades the 2027-04-21 opening auction, where the settlement's first prints are artifacts rather than information) and licenses nothing. No house playbook is opex- or vol-settlement-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped 2026-09-05 for opex|expiration|witching|SOQ|tax day, zero hits in both).
